meta.name: Northwind Labs
meta.reviewCadence: Every 12 months, and after any rebrand or platform change
assumptions: Brand colours were extracted from the logo; confirm exact values against the master artwork or existing specifications.
CMYK values are mathematical conversions; confirm with your printer and choose Pantone matches from a physical swatch book.
Social platform specifications were last reviewed on the date in the social chapter; verify before production.
Non-interactive run: no questions were asked; defaults below were chosen by the style guide team and need confirmation.
Colour names (Fjord Teal, Polar Night, Daybreak Amber) are proposals; the logo hex values are unchanged.
Typefaces Manrope (display) and Inter (body), both free under SIL OFL 1.1, are recommendations matched to the geometric logo; replace with licensed brand fonts if they exist.
Colour proportions (60% neutral, 20% Fjord Teal, 15% Polar Night, 5% Daybreak Amber) are a proposed starting point.
Corner radius scale (2/4/8/16px) is a proposal reflecting the logo's sharp triangles inside a round container.
Social handles are not known; @northwindlabs is used as an illustrative placeholder and must be confirmed or replaced.
Social platforms set to LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Instagram and web sharing as supplied by the user.
The supplied symbol file (circle with amber peak) is used for avatars, favicons and app icons.
Mission, vision, values, positioning, tagline ('Clear data for climate decisions.') and boilerplate are brand-team drafts; none were supplied. Run trademark and domain checks on the tagline.
Positioning proof point (we publish methods, assumptions and uncertainty) must be confirmed as true before external use.
Voice adds 'Clear' as a fourth attribute; house style uses no serial comma, single quotation marks, spaced en dashes, singular 'data', IPCC-style likelihood terms and metric units first.
Residents and elected members are treated as a secondary audience.
Clear space refined to the height of the lowercase 'o' (about 28% of logo height); minimum digital size raised to 160px so 'LABS' stays legible.
Recommended icon set: Material Symbols Sharp (Apache 2.0). Chart palettes are defined in chapter 09 only (no schema field).
Office font substitutes: Arial for Manrope and Inter, Consolas for JetBrains Mono (Aptos as a Microsoft 365 alternative).
Brand architecture assumed to be a branded house, with products endorsed 'by Northwind Labs'.
Approval turnaround times, social posting frequencies, response times, monitoring hours, record-keeping period and named roles are proposals.
Content pillars and shares (35/20/20/15/10) and the topic hashtag set are proposals; the social chapter's five pillars were adopted over the strategist's three-pillar draft for consistency.
Minimum print sizes (11pt body, 12pt for reports to public bodies, 16pt large print, 24pt slides) and a 2-working-day acknowledgement for accessible-format requests are proposals.
Address, phone, website and registered-company details are placeholders; all example figures in the guide are illustrative, not Northwind Labs data.
Social platform specifications next reviewed 2 April 2027.

foundations.mission: We turn climate data into clear, trustworthy evidence, so city governments and utilities can make better decisions for the places and people they serve.
foundations.vision: A future where every city and utility can plan, invest and act on climate with confidence, because the evidence is clear to everyone who relies on it.

values.name: Show our working
values.description: Trust in climate data is earned through transparency.
values.behaviour: We publish our methods, data sources, assumptions and uncertainty alongside every result.

values.name: Evidence before claims
values.description: We never claim more impact than the data supports.
values.behaviour: We say "estimated", give ranges, and cite the source for every number we publish.

values.name: Clear for everyone
values.description: A result is only useful if the people who act on it can understand it.
values.behaviour: We write a plain-language summary for every technical output, and we design to WCAG 2.2 AA.

values.name: Progress together
values.description: Climate action is shared work between cities, utilities, partners and residents.
values.behaviour: We credit partners and customers accurately, and we share what we learn, including what did not work.

foundations.positioning: For city sustainability officers and utility engineers who must make high-stakes climate decisions with complex and incomplete data, Northwind Labs is the climate data analytics partner that turns that data into clear, decision-ready evidence, because we show our methods, our assumptions and our uncertainty, not just our answers.

audiences.name: City sustainability officers
audiences.needs: Clear findings they can reuse in council papers, honest uncertainty, and progress they can report

audiences.name: Utility engineers
audiences.needs: Correct units, explicit methods, data definitions, and outputs that fit their tools

audiences.name: Investors
audiences.needs: Verifiable metrics, clear risks, and no overstated climate impact

audiences.name: Climate-tech partners
audiences.needs: Clear roles, accurate joint claims, integration detail and brand rules for co-branding

boilerplate.short: Northwind Labs turns climate data into clear, decision-ready evidence for city governments and utilities, so they can plan, invest and act with confidence.
boilerplate.medium: Northwind Labs is a climate data analytics company working with city governments and utilities. We turn complex climate and energy data into clear evidence that sustainability officers, engineers and investors can act on. We show our methods and our uncertainty, so every decision rests on evidence people can check.
boilerplate.long: Northwind Labs is a climate data analytics company working with city governments and utilities. Cities and utilities face long-term, high-stakes decisions about energy, infrastructure and emissions, often with complex and incomplete data. We turn that data into clear, decision-ready evidence that sustainability officers, utility engineers, investors and partners can understand and act on. We show our methods, our assumptions and our uncertainty, so every result can be checked and explained to the people it affects. We believe better evidence leads to better climate decisions. To find out more, email hello@northwindlabs.example.

foundations.industry: Climate data analytics for city governments and utilities

logo.description: A combination mark: on the left, a Fjord Teal circle holding a Daybreak Amber upward-pointing triangle with a smaller teal triangle cut from its base, forming an open peak or chevron; on the right, the word 'Northwind' in a heavy, geometric lowercase sans-serif in Polar Night, followed by 'LABS' in small, spaced capitals in Fjord Teal, aligned to the baseline.

clearSpace.rule: Keep clear space equal to the height of the lowercase 'o' in 'Northwind' (about 28% of the logo height) on all sides.

misuse: Don't stretch, squash or change its proportions.
Don't rotate or tilt the logo or the peak.
Don't recolour the logo, or any part of it, outside the approved versions.
Don't add effects such as shadows, glows, bevels, gradients or outlines.
Don't rearrange, resize or space out the symbol, "Northwind" or "LABS".
Don't place the logo on busy photos, patterns or low-contrast backgrounds.
Don't put the logo inside shapes, badges or frames that are not in this guide.
Don't use old, redrawn or traced versions. Download the current files.
Don't type "Northwind Labs" in another font next to the symbol in place of the wordmark.
Don't crop the logo or let it bleed off the edge of a page or screen.
Don't use the plain single-colour fill that hides the peak. Use the knockout version.
Don't turn the peak into an arrow, bullet or decorative pattern.
